X-Rate-Limited-By.description: Identifies the rate limiter that triggered the 429 response.

Bic.description: Business Identifier Code, also known as Swift Code.

transactionReference.description: Transaction reference as received in the 3DS challenge webhook event.

challengeStatus.description: The customer's response to the 3DS challenge.

ActivityStatus.description:
Status of the Activity.
- `REQUIRES_ATTENTION` - Requires an end user attention.
- `IN_PROGRESS` - Indicates that this activity has yet to be completed. (Example: In progress Top Up)
- `UPCOMING` - Indicates that this activity is scheduled to happen in the future. By default these activities will only be shown 2 days before the date. (Example: A scheduled transfer)
- `COMPLETED` - Indicates that this activity is at its end state. (Example: A completed Top Up)
- `CANCELLED` - Indicates that this activity is cancelled. (Example: A Top Up is cancelled)

Activity.description: Activity represents a snapshot of a performed action for a profile.

resource.description: The resource associated with the activity.

id.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

title.description:
Title of the Activity.

Value can be formatted with custom tags to put emphasis on important wordings.

Supported custom tags:
- `<strong>`: Indicates strong emphasis on words that the end user should pay attention to.
- `<positive>`: Indicates a positive transaction (e.g., top up to balance is successful).
- `<negative>`: Indicates a negative transaction (e.g., amount is deducted from a balance).
- `<strikethrough>`: (Coming soon) Indicates the negation of an activity (e.g., transfer is cancelled).

description.description: A short description that briefly summarizes the activity.

primaryAmount.description:
A currency formatted text that describe the primary amount of transaction.

Value of this field is intended to have units in it and should not be treated as a numeric value.

One example of primaryAmount would be: "Topping up 100 USD balance with 80 GBP". In this case `100 USD` would be the primaryAmount of the activity.

secondaryAmount.description:
A currency formatted text that describe the secondary amount of transaction.

Value of this field is intended to have units in it and should not be treated as a numeric value.
Value can be empty if there is no good candidate as secondary amount.

One example of secondaryAmount would be: "Topping up 100 USD balance with 80 GBP". In this case `80 GBP` would be the secondaryAmount of the activity.

createdOn.description: Timestamp when the activity was created.

updatedOn.description: Timestamp when the activity was last modified.

occupations.description: User occupations. Required for CA, IN, JP, ID, IL, MX, and within the US for state NM.

Type of balance account.
- `STANDARD` - Standard balance account. Only one per currency per profile.
- `SAVINGS` - Savings balance (Jar). Multiple allowed per currency.

Balance.description: Represents a balance account within a profile.

name.description: Name of the balance. Required for SAVINGS balances.

investmentState.description:
Investment state of the balance.
- `NOT_INVESTED` - Balance is not invested.
- `INVESTED` - Balance is invested in assets.
- `INVESTING` - Balance is being invested into assets.
- `DIVESTING` - Balance is being divested from assets.
- `UNKNOWN` - Investment state is unknown.

creationTime.description: Date when the balance was created.

modificationTime.description: Date when the balance was last modified.

visible.description: Whether the balance is visible to the user.

x-enumDescriptions.CLOSED: Hold limit breach is closed and resolved.

x-enumDescriptions.MANUALLY_RESOLVED: The breach was closed by calling the [Close Hold Limit Breach](/api-reference/balance/holdlimitbreachclose) endpoint with a specified recipient.

updatedAt.description: Date when the hold limit breach was last modified.

BankAccountDetails.title: Bank Account Details
BankAccountDetails.description: Bank account details for receiving money into a Wise Multi-Currency Account.

id.description: Bank account details ID. Returns `null` for preview account details that have not yet been issued.

currency.description: Currency information for the bank account details.

status.description:
Account details status:
- `AVAILABLE`: Account details do not exist for the user but may be created
- `ACTIVE`: Account details are ready to be used by this user

deprecated.description: When `true`, Wise has issued new account details for the same currency. Users should not use the deprecated account but may still have external references to it.

receiveOptions.description:
Available receive options for the given currency:
- `LOCAL`: Local bank details to receive money in the account currency
- `INTERNATIONAL`: SWIFT bank details to receive money internationally

title.description: Display title for this receive option.

body.example: Receive from a bank in the Eurozone

Account details to display to users. This array varies by currency.
For example, EUR returns `ACCOUNT_HOLDER`, `SWIFT_CODE`, `IBAN` and `BANK_NAME_AND_ADDRESS`.

hidden.description: Whether the field should be hidden in the UI.

PayInDetails.description: Pay-in details describe how the batch group can be funded. Only populated when a batch group is in the `COMPLETED` state.

reference.description: The reference that should be used when funding the transfers in the batch group. This reference should be treated as an opaque value and there should be no attempt to decode or decompose it.

amount.description: The total pay-in amount for all transactions in the batch when paying in with this reference and method.

name.description: Name of the bank account holder.

branchName.description: Name of the bank branch. Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as JPY).

accountType.description: Bank account type. Provided only when the currency route requires it.

bankCode.description: Bank identifier or routing number, depending on pay-in type and currency.

bankAddress.description: Address for the receiving bank. Provided only when the currency route requires it.

transferWiseAddress.description: Wise's address. Provided only when the currency route requires it.

firstLine.example: 6th Floor, The Tea Building, 56 Shoreditch High Street

iban.description: ISO 13616 International Bank Account Number (when available).

bban.description: Basic Bank Account Number (BBAN). Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as NOK).

institutionNumber.description: Financial Institution number (3 digits). Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as CAD).

transitNumber.description: Branch Transit Number (5 digits). Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as CAD).

beneficiaryBankBIC.description: Beneficiary Bank Business Identifier Code (BIC). Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as CAD).

intermediaryBankBIC.description: Intermediary Bank Business Identifier Code (BIC). Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as CAD).

fpsIdentifier.description: Faster Payment System identifier. Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as HKD).

clearingNumber.description: Clearing number. Provided only when the currency route requires it (such as SEK).

version.description:
Batch version, used for concurrency control. This number is updated whenever there is a change to the batch group state (its status, the identity of the transfers in the batch, etc).

Some API operations require this version in requests, and operations may be rejected when the requested version does not match the server's version.

The version is a signed integer and is not ordered with respect to any previous version.

name.description: Descriptive name for the batch group.

sourceCurrency.description: Source currency code (ISO 4217 Alphabetic Code). This currency is expected to be used for funding the batch group.

status.description:
Current batch group status:
- `NEW` — New batch group with zero or more transfers. Able to have more transfers added to it. Transfers in a `NEW` group cannot yet be funded and paid out.
- `COMPLETED` — The batch group has had all desired transfers added and is now closed to further changes. Transfers in the group can now be funded and paid out. Note: `COMPLETED` does not imply payouts have been successfully completed.
- `MARKED_FOR_CANCELLATION` — Cancellation of the transfers in the batch group was requested.
- `PROCESSING_CANCEL` — Transfers in the group are being cancelled.
- `CANCELLED` — Transfers in the group have been cancelled.

transferIds.description: The IDs of all transfers successfully added to the group.

payInDetails.description:
List of pay-in details describing how the batch group can be funded. Provided only when the batch group is in the `COMPLETED` state.

Currently supported types: `bank_transfer`.

reference.description: Payment reference that will be passed to the network. Can be used for reconciliation.

userId.description: The ID of the user who initiated this payment.

profileId.description: The ID of the profile this payment belongs to.

status.description:
Payment initiation status:
- `NEW` — Payment initiation created
- `PROCESSING` — Payment is being processed
- `COMPLETED` — Payment completed successfully
- `FAILED` — Payment failed
- `CHARGED_BACK` — Payment was charged back

accountId.description: External account ID associated with the payment.

transferId.description: Transfer ID of the direct debit payment. Present only after the direct debit is initiated.

createdTime.description: Date and time when the payment initiation was created.

Card.description: The Card resource represents a Wise card linked to a profile.

profileId.description: Profile ID that owns this card.

clientId.description: Client ID of the partner that issued the card.

value.description:
Status value. One of:
- `ACTIVE` - Card is active and can be used
- `INACTIVE` - Card is inactive and all transactions will be declined
- `BLOCKED` - Card is blocked and cannot be reversed back to any state
- `FROZEN` - Card is temporarily blocked
- `PARTNER_SUSPENDED` - Card is suspended by Wise temporarily (do not display to end customers)
- `EXPIRED` - Card is expired
- `PURGED` - Cardholder data (e.g. PAN, PIN) has been purged after the retention period (555 days after the card's expiry date)

expiryDate.description: Date when the card will expire.

lastFourDigits.description: Last 4 digits of the card number.

bankIdentificationNumber.description: Bank identification number (BIN) of the card.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number associated with the card.

cardType.description: Type of the card. E.g. `PHYSICAL` or `VIRTUAL`.

unlockSpendingPermissions.description:
Method with which physical card spending permissions can be unlocked. One of:
- `WITH_PARTNER_API` - Unlock via Partner API
- `WITH_FIRST_CHIP_AND_PIN_TRANSACTION` - Unlock with first chip and PIN transaction
- `NONE` - Not applicable (for virtual cards)

creationTime.description: Time when the card was created.

modificationTime.description: Time when the card was last modified.

Permission.description: Spending permission configuration for a card.

type.description:
The type of transaction this permission controls.

Permissions available on all cards:
- `ECOM` - Online transactions
- `ATM_WITHDRAWAL` - ATM withdrawals
- `MOBILE_WALLETS` - Digital wallet payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay)

Additional permissions available on physical cards:
- `POS_MAGSTRIPE` - Physical point-of-sale transactions with magnetic stripe
- `POS_CONTACTLESS` - Physical point-of-sale contactless transactions
- `POS_CHIP` - Physical point-of-sale transactions with chip

Virtual cards do not return physical point-of-sale permissions. Only permissions returned for the card can be updated.

isEnabled.description: Indicates if this permission type is enabled.

isLocked.description: Indicates if this permission is locked. If `true`, this permission cannot be updated.

ProductionStatus.description: Represents the production status of a card at a kiosk machine.

status.description:
Current production status:
- `READY` - Card is ready for production
- `IN_PROGRESS` - Card is in production at the kiosk machine
- `PRODUCED` - Card is produced and collected. This is a final state
- `PRODUCTION_ERROR` - Card production failed
- `REQUEST_ERROR` - Card production request failed

kioskId.description: Identifier that specifies which kiosk machine is producing the card. When the status is `READY`, this value is null.

occurredAt.description: Time when the card production request has been sent to the kiosk machine (ISO 8601 format).

errorCode.description:
Code returned when card production is not successful. Nullable.

**Request errors** - Returned when `status` is `REQUEST_ERROR`:
- `UNKNOWN_ERROR` - An error occurred on the server
- `REQUEST_ALREADY_EXISTS` - The request has already been submitted
- `KIOSK_ID_NOT_FOUND` - The kiosk ID does not exist
- `CARD_TYPE_NOT_FOUND` - The card type does not exist
- `INVALID_FIELD_VALUE` - Some field values are unexpected
- `INVALID_PIN_FORMAT` - The PIN does not follow ISO0 or ISO2 standard
- `EMPTY_OR_NULL_FIELD_VALUE` - Some required fields are empty or null
- `EMPTY_OR_NULL_OR_WRONG_SIZE_FIELD_VALUE` - Some required fields are empty, null, or have incorrect lengths
- `CHARSET_NOT_SUPPORTED` - The character set for some fields is not supported
- `INVALID_FIELD_FORMAT` - Some field formats are invalid
- `INVALID_FIELD_ENCODING` - The encoding for some fields is not expected
- `CDATA_ENCODING_OR_FORMATING_ERROR` - The encoding or formatting for XML text field values is incorrect
- `PIN_LENGTH_ERROR` - The PIN length is incorrect
- `PIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED` - The PIN cannot be verified because the server is unreachable
- `DATA_PREPARATION_FAILED` - The server failed to parse the request
- `PARTIAL_DATA_RECEIVED` - Only part of the expected data has been received
- `NO_BRANCH_LINKED_TO_KIOSK` - The kiosk has not been linked to any branch
- `IMAGE_SERVER_ERROR` - The image server is unreachable or failed to process the data
- `PAN_ALREADY_EXISTS` - The PAN already exists
- `PRINTER_OR_SATELLITE_NOT_READY` - The printer or satellite is not ready to start the production
- `REQUEST_CREATED_BUT_NOT_STARTED` - The request has been created, but production is pending until the printer or satellite is ready
- `UNABLE_TO_ACCEPT_REQUEST` - The system is currently busy and cannot accept new requests at this time

**Production errors** - Returned when `status` is `PRODUCTION_ERROR`:
- `CB_NOT_AVAILABLE` - Main server error: central base not available
- `CB_DB_NOT_AVAILABLE` - Main server error: database not available
- `CB_NETWORK_NOT_AVAILABLE` - Main server error: network not available
- `CB_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` - Main server error: user authentication verification failed
- `CB_SERVICE_NOT_ALLOWED` - Main server error: the accessed service requires a higher security level
- `CB_TIME` - Main server error: timeout occurred on the Central Base side
- `DP_NOT_AVAILABLE` - Data processing error: the Data preparation module is not available
- `DP_IO_ERROR` - Data processing error: Input/Output error when communicating with the DP
- `DP_TIMEOUT` - Data processing error: timeout error
- `SAT_SERVER_NOT_REACHABLE` - Satellite agent error: the server is not reachable
- `SAT_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` - Satellite agent error: user authentication failed on satellite
- `SAT_NETWORK_NOT_AVAILABLE` - Satellite agent error: the network is not available
- `PRT_NOT_REACHABLE` - Printer error: printer is not reachable
- `PRT_SETUP_ERROR` - Printer error: printer setup is incorrect
- `PRT_TIMEOUT` - Printer error: printer timeout
- `PRT_RIBBON` - Printer error: ribbon error
- `PRT_LOCK_ERROR` - Printer error: printer physically unlocked
- `PRT_RIBBON_MISSING` - Printer error: ribbon is missing
- `PRT_RIBBON_ENDED` - Printer error: ribbon has ended
- `PRT_COVER_OPEN` - Printer error: printer cover is open
- `PRT_PAUSED` - Printer error: printer paused
- `PRD_UNEXPECTED_DATA` - Production error: production data is incorrect
- `PRD_FEEDER_EMPTY` - Production error: feeder is empty
- `PRD_FEEDER_JAM` - Production error: feeder card jam
- `PRD_HOPPER_FULL` - Production error: hopper is full
- `PRD_HOPPER_DOOR` - Production error: hopper door is open
- `PRD_HOPPER_JAM` - Production error: hopper card jam
- `PRD_MAGSTRIPE` - Production error: error occurred during magstripe encoding
- `PRD_SMARTCARD` - Production error: error occurred during chip personalization
- `PRD_EMBOSSER` - Production error: error occurred during embossing
- `PRD_TIMEOUT` - Production error: production timeout has been reached
- `PRD_REJECT_FULL` - Production error: reject box is full
- `PRD_SMARTCARD_CARD_NOT_IN_READER` - Production error: card is not in reader
- `PRD_FINAL_VALIDATION_NOK` - Production error: user has rejected card production
- `INV_NOT_INITIALIZED` - Production error: inventory not initialized
- `UNKNOWN_ERROR` - Unknown error

cardProgram.description: The card program associated with this card order. A Card Program is what Wise refers to all the cards that you will be issuing with us, grouped by product type and by issuing country.

The network of the card program:

- `VISA`

defaultCurrency.description: The default currency assigned to the card program.

See the [card address validation guide](/guides/developer/api-guides/card-address-validation) for country-specific fields and validation rules.

deliveryEstimate.description:
The estimated time when the card will be delivered. There are few scenarios to be mindful of:

1. For virtual card the delivery estimate will be close to the creationTime, as it does not require delivery.
2. For physical card in `PLACED` status, the delivery estimate is calculated assuming that the order requirements will be fulfilled today (refreshed daily).
3. For physical card after `PLACED` status, we provide a best effort estimation, and it should not be used as delivery timing as we will have separate delivery tracking (subject to region availability) for physical card that is coming soon.

deliveryOption.description: The delivery option used on the card order.

CardTransaction.title: Card Transaction
CardTransaction.description: The `debits` and `credits` fields are only present when retrieving a single transaction by ID, and will not be present in the list transactions response.

state.description:
The current [state](/api-reference/card-transaction#card-transaction-state) of the transaction. One of:
- `IN_PROGRESS`
- `COMPLETED`
- `DECLINED`
- `CANCELLED`
- `UNKNOWN`

detailedDeclineReason.description: Code of the [detailed decline reason](/api-reference/card-transaction#card-transaction-detailed-decline-reasons) if applicable

modificationTime.description: When the transaction was last updated

purgeTime.description: Time at which reserved funds will be released after the authorisation hold expires

zipCode.description: Zip code where merchant is located

approvalCode.description: Also called authorization code. This can be used to prove ownership of a customer's card/account to a merchant

balanceChannelReferenceId.description: Balance channel reference ID associated with the card transaction

debits.description:
Array of debits. Only present when retrieving a single transaction by ID.

The debits list is a non-aggregated list of debit movements, meaning that the `balanceId` is not unique in the list. For example, a cancelled transaction may have a list of 2 debits where the absolute values of `debitedAmount.amount`, `forAmount.amount` and `fee.amount` are the same, but one is the negation of the other due to a reservation (first debit) which was then released (second debit with negated amounts). You can choose to perform the aggregation in your system or display the full list of debits to the end customer.

rate.description: Exchange rate of debitedAmount to forAmount

credits.description: Array of credits. Only present when retrieving a single transaction by ID

relayAuthorisationData.description: Relayed authorisation response data, only available if the partner has opted in for [relayed authorisation](/guides/product/issue-cards/relayed-authorisation)

responseCode.description:
[ResponseCode](/guides/product/issue-cards/relayed-authorisation#authorisation-response) of the relayed authorisation. One of:
- `APPROVED`
- `PROCESSING_ERROR`
- `NON_SUPPORTED_CURRENCY`
- `NON_SUPPORTED_MCC_FOR_COUNTRY`
- `BLOCKED_COUNTRY`
- `TRANSACTION_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED`
- `SUSPECTED_FRAUD`

code.description:
The type of reasons available for the dispute. Top-level codes include `ATM_DISPENSED_NO_FUNDS`, `WRONG_AMOUNT`, `TROUBLE_WITH_GOODS_SERVICES`, `MERCHANT_CHARGED_AGAIN`, `NO_REFUND`, `UNAUTHORIZED`.

kyc-requirement.title: KYC Requirement
kyc-requirement.description: An object returned as part of the [KYC Review](/api-reference/kyc-review/kyc-review) object, which includes information about a required evidence, its state, and any additional information that might be required.

key.description: The name of the KYC requirement. A single KYC Requirement should appear in the requirements list at most once.

state.description:
The state of the KYC requirement.
- `NOT_PROVIDED` — the information is pending. Either the Hosted KYC flow or [KYC Requirement Submit](/api-reference/kyc-review/kycreviewrequirementsubmit) endpoint should be used to fulfil the requirement.
- `IN_REVIEW` — the required information has been retrieved and the KYC requirement is being reviewed. No action is needed.
- `VERIFIED` — the required information has been received and verified on our side. No action is needed.

apiCollectionSupported.description: Indicates if the requirement can be provided via the [KYC Requirement Submit](/api-reference/kyc-review/kycreviewrequirementsubmit) endpoint. If `false`, the requirement should be provided via the Hosted KYC flow.

additionalRequirements.description: List of additional submissions that are needed to fulfill this requirement. These can appear when the originally submitted evidence is a wrong document, wrong format, incomplete or otherwise insufficient. Only provided if not empty.

additionalRequirementId.description: Unique identifier for an additional requirement, generated by Wise.

key.description: A key outlining what type of evidence is additionally required

state.description:
The state of the additional requirement. This state should be treated as independent of the parent KYC Requirement's state. They can, but don't have to, change together.
- `NOT_PROVIDED` — the information is pending. Either the Hosted KYC flow or [KYC Requirement Submit](/api-reference/kyc-review/kycreviewrequirementsubmit) endpoint should be used to fulfil the additional requirement.
- `IN_REVIEW` — the required information has been retrieved and the additional requirement is being reviewed. No action is needed.
- `VERIFIED` — the required information has been received and verified on our side. No action is needed.

reasons.description: Contains information about the reason this additional requirement has been requested.

errorCode.description: Code for the reason this additional requirement has been requested.

description.example: The provided document or information has expired. A valid document is required.

dateTime.description: Timestamp marking when this additional requirement was requested.

attributes.description: Contains metadata information about the additional requirement. Not returned if empty.

name.description: The name of the affected person(s) or business

website.description: The URL of the affected website

businessName.description: The name of the affected business

owningBusinessName.description: The name of the affected owning business

Requirement details were unclear, *please* provide a clear scan where:

*   The document is in colour

validUntil.description: If present, indicates the expiry date of this version (ISO 8601).

The keys within this object vary depending on the parent requirement `key`. See the [KYC requirement types](/guides/product/kyc/wise-kyc/kyc-requirement-types) guide for details on which requirement types support attributes and what keys they contain.

kyc-review.title: KYC Review
kyc-review.description: The return object of most KYC Review endpoints, which includes information about the given KYC Review such as status, trigger references, and a list of [KYC Requirements](api-reference/kyc-review/kyc-requirement).

id.description: Unique identifier for a KYC Review resource, generated by Wise.

status.description: Aggregated state of the underlying requirement set. Any of the states below could move into any other state.

createdAt.description: Timestamp marking the creation of the KYC Review.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp marking the last update of the KYC Review.

requiredBy.description: Timestamp by which the underlying requirement set needs to be verified to not block the customer. Only relevant if the status is `PASSED_WITH_REQUIREMENTS`.

items.description: An object that refers to the action or process this KYC Review pertains to.

type.description:
Type of the underlying action or process this KYC Review is for. Usually a reference to which product this KYC Review pertains to (like `QUOTE` or `TRANSFER`) or a reference to a KYC process on the profile that isn't related to a specific product (like `REFRESH_CYCLE` or `REPAPERING`).

Currently supported types:
- `QUOTE`
- `TRANSFER`
- `PROACTIVE_SEND_MONEY`
- `ADD_MONEY`
- `CARD`
- `BANK_ACCOUNT_DETAILS`
- `INFO_REQUEST`

triggerData.description:
Key-value object containing metadata of the underlying product object that triggered the KYC Review.
For `QUOTE`, `TRANSFER` and `ADD_MONEY` types, `triggerData` contains an `id` field that refers to their respective IDs.
For `BANK_ACCOUNT_DETAILS`, `triggerData` has a field called `currencies` which contains a list of currencies (e.g. USD, SGD, EUR) that the bank details have been created for.

Fields and their data types for each `triggerReference.type`:
- `QUOTE` - `id` (uuid)
- `TRANSFER` - `id` (long)
- `ADD_MONEY` - `id` (long)
- `BANK_ACCOUNT_DETAILS` - `currencies` (list of string)

redirectUrl.description: URL where the user will be redirected at the end of the flow. Can contain query params and path fragments. It has to be a valid URL as per [RFC 2396](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2396.txt). Provided by the caller in the [Update redirect URL](kycreviewredirecturlupdate) call.

requirements.description:
Nested list of [KYC Requirement](api-reference/kyc-review/kyc-requirement) objects in `[[Requirement]]` format, where each inner list represents a combination of possible requirements to be provided. To fulfil the whole KYC Review, at least one item from each inner list should be provided.

For example, if the requirements are `[[a, b], [c, d]]` then it should be read as `(a or b) and (c or d)`.

content-attributes.title: Attributes Content (REQUEST messages)
content-attributes.description:
Content structure for REQUEST messages (e.g., DEPOSIT_SANCTION_HIT_REQUEST).
Contains dynamic attributes that define what information is required from the partner.

The attributes object contains ALL possible entity types for the case subtype.
The partner should submit data for ONE of the entity types.

attributes.description: Dynamic attributes defining required information for each entity type.

content-submission-data.description: Content structure for SUBMISSION messages containing partner-submitted data.

content-text.description: Content structure for FREEFORM messages containing free text conversation.

case-message-content.description:
The content of a case message. The structure varies based on the message type:

- **attributes**: Present in *_REQUEST messages. Contains dynamic attributes defining required information.
- **submissionData**: Present in *_SUBMISSION messages. Contains partner-submitted data.
- **text**: Present in FREEFORM messages. Contains free text conversation.

case-message.description: A message within a support case.

Timestamp when the message was created.

case-2.description: A support case with its complete details including messages and references.

profileId.description: The profile ID associated with this case.

updatedAt.description:

validation-error.title: Validation Error
validation-error.description: Details about a specific field validation error.

field.description:
The field path that caused the validation error.
Uses dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `submissionData.individual.name`).

message.description: Description of what validation rule was violated.

rejectedValue.description: The value that was rejected (if applicable).

error-response.title: Error Response
error-response.description:
Standard error response structure returned by the API.

All error responses follow this consistent format with an error code,
human-readable message, and optional validation errors array.

error.description:
Machine-readable error code indicating the type of error.

Common codes:
- `BAD_REQUEST` - Invalid request format or parameters
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` - Request body validation failed
- `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` - Requested resource does not exist
- `UNAUTHORIZED` - Authentication required or failed
- `FORBIDDEN` - Insufficient permissions
- `CONFLICT` - Operation conflicts with current state
- `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` - Unexpected server error

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the error occurred.

path.description: The request path that caused the error.

errors.description:
List of field-level validation errors.
Only present for validation errors (HTTP 400).

allOf.title: Bad Request Error (400)
allOf.description:
Returned when the request is malformed or contains invalid data.

**Common causes:**
- Missing required fields (`type`, `submissionData`)
- Invalid enum values for `type`
- Malformed JSON in request body
- Invalid field values that fail validation

allOf.title: Unauthorized Error (401)
allOf.description:
Returned when authentication is missing or invalid.

**Common causes:**
- Missing `Authorization` header
- Invalid or expired API token
- Malformed authorization header format

allOf.title: Forbidden Error (403)
allOf.description:
Returned when the authenticated client lacks permission to access the resource.

**Common causes:**
- Case belongs to a different partner (client key mismatch)
- Attempting to access a case type not permitted for this client

example.message: You do not have permission to access this resource

allOf.title: Not Found Error (404)
allOf.description:
Returned when the requested case does not exist.

**Common causes:**
- Invalid `caseId` that doesn't exist
- Case was deleted or archived
- Typo in the case ID

submission-data-freeform.title: FREEFORM Submission Data
submission-data-freeform.description:
Submission data for FREEFORM message type.
Used for general text-based communication on a case.

**Prerequisites:**
- Case must not be in RESOLVED or FAILED status

**Validation Rules:**
- `freeText` is REQUIRED and must be non-blank

freeText.description:
The free-form text message to submit.
Can include additional context, questions, or documentation references.
freeText.example: The transfer has been verified and approved by our compliance team.

example.freeText: Please find attached the requested documentation for this transfer.

submission-individual.title: Individual Submission
submission-individual.description:
Submission data for an individual entity.

**Validation Rules:**
- `name` is REQUIRED for all individual submissions
- `countryOfResidenceIso3` is REQUIRED for:
  - RECIPIENT_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION
  - REFERENCE_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION

countryOfResidenceIso3.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for country of residence.
REQUIRED for RECIPIENT and REFERENCE sanction hit submissions.

dob.description:
Date of birth.
Accepted formats: DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD

submission-organisation.title: Organisation Submission
submission-organisation.description:
Submission data for an organisation entity.

**Validation Rules:**
- All fields marked as required must be non-blank strings
- `countryIso3` must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code

city.description: City where the organisation is located.

postCode.description: Postal code of the organisation's address.

natureOfBusiness.description: Description of the organisation's business activities.

submission-vessel.title: Vessel Submission
submission-vessel.description:
Submission data for a vessel entity.
Only valid for REFERENCE_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION.

**Validation Rules:**
- `vesselImoNumber` is REQUIRED and must be non-blank
- IMO numbers are 7-digit identifiers issued by the International Maritime Organization

vesselImoNumber.description:
International Maritime Organization (IMO) number of the vessel.
IMO numbers are 7 digits, sometimes prefixed with "IMO".

submission-multiple.title: Multiple Submission
submission-multiple.description:
Submission data when multiple entities are involved.
Only valid for REFERENCE_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION.

**Validation Rules:**
- `explanation` is REQUIRED and must be non-blank
- Provide clear details about all entities involved

explanation.description:
Explanation describing the multiple entities involved.
Should include details about all parties and their relationship.
explanation.example: Transfer involves multiple beneficiaries as part of a group payment arrangement.

multiple.explanation: Transfer involves multiple beneficiaries as part of a group payment arrangement for a consortium project.

submission-other.title: Other Submission
submission-other.description:
Submission data for other entity types not covered by standard categories.
Only valid for REFERENCE_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION.

**Validation Rules:**
- `explanation` is REQUIRED and must be non-blank
- Use when the entity doesn't fit individual, organisation, vessel, or multiple categories

explanation.description:
Free-form explanation for the entity.
Describe the entity type and relevant details.
explanation.example: This is a government entity that does not fit standard categories.

other.explanation: This is a government entity that does not fit standard categories. It is the Ministry of Commerce.

submission-data-sanction-hit.title: Sanction Hit Submission Data
submission-data-sanction-hit.description:
Submission data for sanction hit cases. Used for:
- DEPOSIT_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION
- REFERENCE_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION
- RECIPIENT_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION

**Important**: Only ONE of the entity types should be provided per submission.

### Validation Rules by Submission Type:

**DEPOSIT_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION**:
- Must contain either `individual` OR `organisation` (exactly one)

**RECIPIENT_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION**:
- Must contain either `individual` OR `organisation` (exactly one)
- If `individual`, `countryOfResidenceIso3` is REQUIRED

**REFERENCE_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION**:
- Must contain exactly one of: `individual`, `organisation`, `multiple`, `vessel`, or `other`
- If `individual`, `countryOfResidenceIso3` is REQUIRED

submission-reference-location.title: Reference Location Hit Submission
submission-reference-location.description:
Submission data for REFERENCE_LOCATION_HIT_SUBMISSION.
Used when a payment reference triggers a location-based compliance check.

**Validation Rules:**
- All fields in `other` are REQUIRED
- All required fields must be non-blank strings

relatedToLocation.description: Explanation of how the reference is related to the flagged location.
relatedToLocation.example: Payment reference mentions a supplier in Belarus.

paymentExplanation.description: Explanation of the purpose of the payment.

referenceDescription.description: Description of the payment reference that triggered the location hit.
referenceDescription.example: Invoice INV-2026-001 for tractor parts shipped from Minsk warehouse.

other.relatedToLocation: Payment reference mentions a supplier in Belarus.
other.paymentExplanation: Payment for agricultural equipment parts from authorised supplier.
other.referenceDescription: Invoice INV-2026-001 for tractor parts shipped from Minsk warehouse.

submission-recipient-location.title: Recipient Location Hit Submission
submission-recipient-location.description:
Submission data for RECIPIENT_LOCATION_HIT_SUBMISSION.
Used when a recipient's location triggers a compliance check.

**Validation Rules:**
- `relatedToLocation`, `paymentExplanation`, and `location` are REQUIRED
- `businessWebsite` is optional
- All required fields must be non-blank strings

relatedToLocation.description: Explanation of how the recipient is related to the flagged location.
relatedToLocation.example: Recipient has a registered business address in the location.

paymentExplanation.description: Explanation of the purpose of the payment.

other.relatedToLocation: Recipient has a registered branch office in the flagged location.
other.paymentExplanation: Payment for software development services rendered under contract.

submission-data-location-hit.title: Location Hit Submission Data
submission-data-location-hit.description:
Submission data for location hit cases. Used for:
- REFERENCE_LOCATION_HIT_SUBMISSION
- RECIPIENT_LOCATION_HIT_SUBMISSION

Both types require an `other` object with location-specific details.

Request body for submitting a message to a case.

allOf.title: Unprocessable Entity Error (422)
allOf.description:
Returned when the request is syntactically correct but semantically invalid.

**Common causes:**
- Submission type does not match case sub-type (e.g., submitting DEPOSIT_SANCTION_HIT_SUBMISSION for a RECIPIENT_SANCTION_HIT case)
- Missing required fields for the submission type (e.g., `countryOfResidenceIso3` missing for RECIPIENT sanction hit individual)
- Providing both `individual` AND `organisation` when only one is allowed
- Invalid ISO country code format
- Invalid date format for `dob`

profile.description: Personal or business profile ID of the sender. We recommend passing the business profile ID if multiple users manage your business account so all users authorized on the business account can access the recipient.

ownedByCustomer.description:
Indicates whether the recipient account is owned by the profile owner.

While optional, we recommend setting to `true` for self-transfers (such as a user sending money to their own account in another country or currency).
Distinguishing self-transfers from third-party transfers improves routing and processing efficiency.

details.description:

ultimateBeneficiary.description: The details about the ultimate beneficiary for this recipient, if present. If absent, the ultimate beneficiary _is_ the recipient.

A one-time token is generated when accessing an endpoint secured by SCA. This token includes a list of all available challenges to complete.

You can use the [OTT status endpoint](/api-reference/sca-ott/ottstatusget) to view challenges and their statuses, or use [create SCA session](/api-reference/sca-sessions/scasessioncreate) to manually trigger SCA and return a one-time token.

Machine-readable error code returned with `status: REJECTED`. Each member's documentation notes the `type` values that can produce it and the underlying HTTP status.

    This is the complete set of error codes the API can return today. Consumers should treat unknown codes defensively (new codes may be added); a wildcard fallback to a generic 'funding failed' UI is recommended.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Present if `status = REJECTED`.

Iso20022Address.description: An ISO 20022 structured address with optional free-form address lines.

addressLines.description: Address lines. May be empty; up to two lines can be populated alongside structured fields.

number.description: Account identifier — IBAN, BBAN, or other scheme-specific account number.

bic.description: SWIFT BIC (Business Identifier Code) of the financial institution.

nationalCode.description: Domestic clearing system membership identifier (e.g. UK sort code, US ABA routing number).

Money.description: A monetary value paired with its currency code.

instructed.description: The original amount instructed by the debtor. When not specified by scheme, it equals interbankSettlement.

interbankSettlement.description: The amount settled between the instructing and instructed agent on the final interbank leg.

credited.description: The amount credited to the creditor's Wise balance. Computed as interbankSettlement, after any FX conversion and Wise fees.

type.description: Category of the Wise fee. Additional fee types will be added in future versions.

value.description: Decimal fee amount deducted by the correspondent bank.

agent.description: The financial institution that deducted this fee. Omitted when the charging agent is not identified in the payment message.

wise.description: Fees charged by Wise (e.g. conversion fee, handling fee). Empty array when no Wise fees apply.

correspondent.description:
Fees deducted by correspondent or intermediary banks before the funds reached Wise. Each
entry includes the charging agent when available in the pacs message. Array is empty where
there are no charges.

id.description: Unique identifier for the incoming transfer. UUID-formatted string.

profileId.description: Profile ID of the balance owner.

balanceId.description: Balance ID associated with the incoming transfer. This is the balance that was credited.

accountDetailsId.description:
Account details ID that received the incoming transfer. A balance may have multiple account
details (e.g. multiple IBANs). This identifies the specific one that was credited. Omitted
when the payment was received via correspondent model.

state.description: Current state of the incoming transfer. Additional states will be added in the future.

creditTransferType.description:
- `CUSTOMER_CREDIT_TRANSFER` - End-user or corporate payment where at least one side (debtor
  or creditor) is a non-financial institution.
- `FI_CREDIT_TRANSFER` - Direct bank-to-bank settlement, liquidity movement, or cover
  transfer where both parties are financial institutions.

scheme.description: The payment scheme through which the incoming transfer was received.

endToEndId.description:
End-to-end identifier assigned by the debtor for reconciliation purposes. Omitted when not
provided by the debtor.

uetr.description:
Universal End-to-End Transaction Reference. A globally unique identifier (UUID v4) assigned
by the debtor agent to track the payment across the entire chain. UUID-formatted string.

unstructuredReference.description:
Unstructured remittance information provided by the debtor. Free-text field carried through
the payment rail.

creditedTime.description: Timestamp when the incoming transfer was credited to the balance.

debtor.description: The debtor (ordering party) of the incoming transfer.

creditor.description: The creditor (beneficiary) of the incoming transfer.

amounts.description: Payment amount waterfall representing the flow of funds: instructed → interbankSettlement → credited.

exchangeRate.description:
Wise's effective FX rate applied to this incoming transfer (source currency → target balance
currency) as a decimal number. 1 when no conversion was needed.

chargeBearer.description: Charge bearer code indicating who pays the transaction fees. Omitted if not specified in the payment message.

previousInstructingAgents.description:
Financial institutions that previously instructed this payment (the historical chain the
payment passed through before reaching Wise). Ordered by position in the chain.

fees.description:
Breakdown of fees applied to the incoming transfer. Contains both Wise fees and
correspondent/intermediary bank fees.

LookupGpiTrackingRequestContent.description: Identify the transfer to look up by `UETR` or `TRANSFER_ID`.

identifierType.description: The type of identifier used to look up the transfer.

identifier.description: The UETR or Wise transfer ID of the transfer to look up, matching `identifierType`. Must be a UUID (e.g. `97ed4827-7b6f-4491-a206-42bcf859a919`) when `identifierType` is `UETR`, or a positive integer (int64) (e.g. `16521632`) when `identifierType` is `TRANSFER_ID`.

GpiTrackingSettlementMethod.description: Settlement method reported for an ACSP sub-status.

code.description: Settlement method code, passed through as a SWIFT gpi settlement method code. Known values: `INDA`, `INGA`, `COVE`, `CLRG`. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

clearingSystem.description: Clearing system, present when the settlement method is `CLRG`.

code.description: Sub-status code, passed through as a SWIFT gpi transaction status reason code. Known values: `G000`, `G001`, `G002`, `G003`, `G004`, `G005`, `G006`. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

instructedAgent.description: BIC the transaction was forwarded to. Present for `G000`, `G001`, `G005`, `G006`.

GpiTrackingMoney.description: A monetary value represented using the GPI tracking wire format.

GpiTrackingCancellationStatus.description: Cancellation status of a tracked transaction.

GpiTrackingCancellationRequestStatus.description: Cancellation request status reported for an event.

reasonCode.description: Cancellation reason code, passed through as a SWIFT gpi cancellation reason code. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

indemnityAgreement.description: Whether an indemnity agreement applies to the cancellation request.

GpiTrackingCancellationResponseStatus.description: Cancellation response status reported for an event.

code.description: Cancellation response code, passed through as a SWIFT gpi cancellation response code. Known values: `CNCL` (cancelled), `PDCR` (pending), `RJCR` (rejected). Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

reasonCode.description: Cancellation response reason code, passed through as a SWIFT gpi cancellation response reason code. Present for `PDCR` and `RJCR`.

GpiTrackingCharge.description: A charge applied while processing the transaction.

GpiTrackingEvent.description: An event reported for a tracked transaction.

status.description: Status conveyed by this event, passed through as a SWIFT gpi transaction status code. Known values: `ACSP` (accepted, settlement in progress), `ACCC` (accepted, settlement completed), `RJCT` (rejected). Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

statusReason.description: Sub-status detail, present when status is `ACSP`.

statusTime.description: When this status was reached. Present when status is `ACSP` or `RJCT`.

confirmedAt.description: When the funds were made available to the creditor. Present when status is `ACCC`.

confirmedAmount.description: Amount credited to the creditor's account. Present when status is `ACCC`.

rejectionReason.description: Rejection reason code, passed through as a SWIFT gpi rejection reason code (ISO 20022 external return/reason code). Present when status is `RJCT`. Known values include `AC04` (closed account number), `AC06` (blocked account), `AM09` (wrong amount), `BE01` (inconsistent with end customer), `RR04` (regulatory reason). Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

instructedAmount.description: Amount as instructed at this hop.

settledAmount.description: Amount as settled at this hop.

amountInconsistency.description: Whether instructed and settled amounts are inconsistent.

sourceCurrency.description: Source currency of the exchange, if any.

targetCurrency.description: Target currency of the exchange, if any.

exchangeRate.description: Exchange rate applied between the source and target currencies.

chargeBearer.description: Charge bearer indicator, passed through as a SWIFT gpi charge bearer code. Known values: `DEBT`, `CRED`, `SHAR`, `SLEV`. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

returnReason.description: Return reason code associated with this event, passed through as a SWIFT gpi return reason code (ISO 20022 external return/reason code). Known values include `AC04` (closed account number), `AC06` (blocked account), `AM09` (wrong amount), `BE01` (inconsistent with end customer), `RR04` (regulatory reason). Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

eventType.description: Type of the tracking event, passed through as a SWIFT gpi tracker event type code. Known values: `PAYMENT`, `STATUS_UPDATE`, `CANCELLATION_REQUEST`, `CANCELLATION_RESPONSE`, `CANCELLATION_REQUEST_STATUS_UPDATE`. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

eventTarget.description: Target of the tracking event, passed through as a SWIFT gpi tracker event target code. Known values: `CREDIT_TRANSFER`, `CREDIT_TRANSFER_RETURN`, `CREDIT_TRANSFER_COVER`, `CREDIT_TRANSFER_COVER_RETURN`, `FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION_CREDIT_TRANSFER`, `FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION_CREDIT_TRANSFER_RETURN`, `FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION_CREDIT_TRANSFER_COVER`, `FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION_CREDIT_TRANSFER_COVER_RETURN`. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

cancellationRequestStatus.description: Cancellation request status conveyed by this event.

cancellationResponseStatus.description: Cancellation response status conveyed by this event.

cancellationRequestTrackingStatus.description: Cancellation request tracking status conveyed by this event, passed through as a SWIFT gpi cancellation request tracking status code. Known values: `S000`, `S001`, `S002`, `S003`, `S004`. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

serviceLevel.description: Service level of the transaction, passed through as a SWIFT gpi service level code. Known values: `G001`, `G002`, `G004`, `G005`, `G009`. Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

charges.description: Charges applied at this hop. Omitted when there are none.

GpiTracking.description: GPI tracking data for a transaction.

uetr.description: The UETR of the tracked transaction.

status.description: Overall tracking status of the transaction, passed through as a SWIFT gpi transaction status code. Known values: `ACSP` (accepted, settlement in progress), `ACCC` (accepted, settlement completed), `RJCT` (rejected). Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

statusReason.description: Sub-status detail, present when status is `ACSP`.

statusTime.description: When this status was reached. Present when status is `ACSP` or `RJCT`.

confirmedAt.description: When the funds were made available to the creditor. Present when status is `ACCC`.

confirmedAmount.description: Amount credited to the creditor's account. Present when status is `ACCC`.

rejectionReason.description: Rejection reason code, passed through as a SWIFT gpi rejection reason code (ISO 20022 external return/reason code). Present when status is `RJCT`. Known values include `AC04` (closed account number), `AC06` (blocked account), `AM09` (wrong amount), `BE01` (inconsistent with end customer), `RR04` (regulatory reason). Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

cancellationStatus.description: Cancellation status, when a cancellation has been requested or resolved.

returnReason.description: Return reason code, present when the transaction was returned or rejected, passed through as a SWIFT gpi return reason code (ISO 20022 external return/reason code). Known values include `AC04` (closed account number), `AC06` (blocked account), `AM09` (wrong amount), `BE01` (inconsistent with end customer), `RR04` (regulatory reason). Additional values may be introduced by SWIFT gpi; see the SWIFT gpi code lists.

- `INACTIVE` - Card is inactive and all transactions will be declined.

- `EXPIRED` - Card is expired.
- `PURGED` - The cardhoder data (ex: PAN, PIN) have been purged after exceeds the retention period (555 days after the card's expiry date).

transaction_type.description:
Type of the transaction. Possible values:
- `ACCOUNT_CREDIT` - Receiving money on the card, excluding Visa OCT or Mastercard MoneySend.
- `ACCOUNT_FUNDING` - Sending money to another card or e-wallet.
- `CASH_ADVANCE` - Cash disbursement.
- `CASH_WITHDRAWAL` - ATM withdrawal.
- `CHARGEBACK` - Currently unused. Reserved for future use.
- `CREDIT_TRANSACTION` - Visa OCT and Mastercard MoneySend.
- `ECOM_PURCHASE` - Online purchase.
- `POS_PURCHASE` - Purchase via a POS terminal.
- `REFUND` - Partial or full refund of an existing card transaction.

transaction_step_type.description:
Step type of the transaction. Possible values:
- `AUTH` - Transaction authorization which is usually the first step.
- `PARTIAL_REVERSAL` - Transaction has been partially reversed.
- `FULL_REVERSAL` - Transaction has been fully reversed.
- `CAPTURE` - Transaction has been captured.
- `SETTLE` - Currently unused. Reserved for future use.
- `REFUND` - Currently unused. Reserved for future use.
- `RECONCILIATION` - Currently unused. Reserved for future use.

transaction_state.description:
The current state of the transaction. Possible values:
- `IN_PROGRESS` - The transaction is still in progress.
- `COMPLETED` - The transaction is completed.
- `DECLINED` - The transaction has been declined.
- `CANCELLED` - The transaction has been cancelled.
- `UNKNOWN` - Default fallback status.

decline_reason.description: Code of the decline reason if applicable.

detailed_decline_reason.description: Code of the detailed decline reason if applicable. See list of [card transaction decline reasons](/api-reference/card-transaction#card-transaction-detailed-decline-reasons).

occurred_at.description: When the transaction state change occurred.

purge_time.description: Time at which reserved funds will be released after the authorisation hold expires.

value.description: Transaction amount, excluding all embedded fees such as ATM fees that are not applied by Wise.

fee_type.description:
Fee type. Possible values:
- `ATM_WITHDRAWAL` - Fee charged by Wise
- `ATM_MACHINE` - Fee charged by the ATM owner

postCode.description: Post code where merchant is located.

state.description: State where merchant is located.

approval_code.description: Also called authorization code. This can be used to prove ownership of a customer's card/account to a merchant.

balance_channel_reference_id.description: Balance channel reference ID associated with the card transaction.

debits.description: Array of debits. Note that the debits list is a non-aggregated list of debit movements, meaning that the `balance_id` is not unique in the list. For example, a cancelled transaction may have a list of 2 debits where the absolute values of `debited_amount.value`, `for_amount.value` and `fee.value` are the same, but one is the negation of the other due to a reservation (first debit) which was then released (second debit with negated amounts). In this case, you can choose to perform the aggregation in your system or display the full list of debits to the end customer.

fallback.description: Whether there was a fallback applied by Wise.

current_state.description:
The current state of the profile. Possible values:
- `ACTIVE` - The profile is active.
- `WITHDRAW_ONLY` - The profile has 90 calendar days to remove their money from their balance before Wise fully deactivates their account. This can be done through sending from their balance to themselves and others or spending with their card. They cannot receive money to their balances and fund transfers from external bank accounts. They can still order new cards, convert between balances, open and close balances, and download balance statements. After 90 calendar days, the profile will move into a `DEACTIVATED` state.
- `VIEW_ONLY` - The profile can access and view balances and account activities such as transfer history and balance statements. However, they can no longer perform actions such as moving money with Wise in any way. All transfers sent to the account after it is set to `VIEW_ONLY` mode will also bounce back to the sender. Cards will also be suspended.
- `DEACTIVATED` - The profile's account is deactivated and no actions can be performed on the account. The end-user tokens will be revoked and you will receive a `401 Unauthorized` response for API calls.

UserToken.description:
User Access Token for making API calls on behalf of a Wise user.

Can be obtained via two OAuth 2.0 flows:
- **registration_code grant**: For partners creating users via API
- **authorization_code grant**: For partners using Wise's authorization page

Access tokens are valid for 12 hours and can be refreshed using a refresh token.

PersonalToken.description:
Personal API Token for individual personal or small business users.
Generated from Wise.com > Settings > Connect and manage apps > API tokens.
Has limited API access compared to OAuth tokens (PSD2 restrictions apply for EU/UK users).

ClientCredentialsToken.description:
Application-level token for partner operations that don't require a specific user context, such as bulk settlement and card spend controls.

Obtained via `POST /oauth/token` with Basic Authentication (client-id:client-secret) and `grant_type=client_credentials`.

Valid for 12 hours. No refresh token — fetch a new token when expired.

See [create an OAuth token](/api-reference/oauth-token/oauthtokencreate) for details.

BasicAuth.description:
Basic Authentication using your Client ID and Client Secret as the username and password.

Client credentials are provided by Wise when your partnership begins. See [Getting Started](/guides/developer) for details.
